parchment.$description: Parchment — Primary page canvas — the warm off-white that gives the entire system its editorial, non-digital feel

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, badge fills, and inset panels — sits one step above the parchment canvas to create gentle elevation without shadows

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, default borders, nav strokes, and structural outlines — the dominant typographic and border color across all contexts

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary headings and heavier-weight text where slightly softer than Ink Black is desired

aubergine-black.$description: Aubergine Black — Dramatic dark-section backgrounds (Problem, full-bleed inverse bands) — the only near-saturated tone, used to invert the page temperature

ash.$description: Ash — Muted text, inactive states, and lighter border treatments where Ink Black would be too heavy

dim.$description: Dim — Captions, timestamps, and tertiary metadata where hierarchy needs to recede

bone.$description: Bone — Hairline borders, illustration fills, and low-emphasis dividers — the lightest structural line color

abcfavorit-book.$description: Single-family system carrying all UI text. The two-weight binary (regular/bold) replaces color or size variation for hierarchy. Weight 400 reads as body and supporting text; weight 700 is reserved for emphasis lines, key headings, and navigation. The two stylistic alternates ss04 and ss11 are enabled globally — these likely alter specific glyphs (likely the 'a' and 'g' or similar) that give ABCfavorit its distinctive contemporary grotesque character.
